execution.rule: execution_ms >= signal_bar_close_ms and >= data_available_ms; stop exits use adverse-cost adjusted stop price; EMA/close exits use the bar close

note: 独立验证器的密封标准。修改本文件须同步更新 validation-standards-v1.sha256，否则 validator 拒绝运行。标准变更须用户批准并记录在 git 历史中。

splits.rule: strictly ordered, non-overlapping; an event window including its holding period must lie within one segment
